claims.claim: The same published passage characterises the townspeople by listing their trades and ending the list with children.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast, Dragon of Icespire Peak boxed text, reprinted in D&D Beyond's Phandalin article
claims.quote: They are farmers, stonecutters, blacksmiths, traders, prospectors, and children
claims.page: 'Tips For Running Phandalin in Your Games', quoted boxed text

claims.claim: The official article's own settlement table gives each location a proprietor and a verbless short description.
claims.source: Mike Bernier, 'Visit Phandalin, D&D's Most Popular Starter Town!', D&D Beyond, 18 Sep 2023
claims.quote: Modest inn for eating, resting, and gossip
claims.page: 'Key NPCs and Locations' table, Stonehill Inn row

claims.claim: That table names a proprietor as given name plus surname with species and gender in parentheses.
claims.source: Mike Bernier, 'Visit Phandalin, D&D's Most Popular Starter Town!', D&D Beyond, 18 Sep 2023
claims.page: 'Key NPCs and Locations' table, Stonehill Inn row

claims.claim: The article instructs the DM to describe a town's layout starting from its street surface and cart tracks.
claims.source: Mike Bernier, 'Visit Phandalin, D&D's Most Popular Starter Town!', D&D Beyond, 18 Sep 2023
claims.quote: Describe the town's layout, from the muddy streets lined with cart tracks

claims.claim: Wizards of the Coast publishes an in-world settlement newspaper as a free handout for the Phandalin adventures.
claims.source: Mike Bernier, 'Downloadable Handout: Read the Latest Edition of the Phandalin Post', D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: a newspaper that covers events in Phandalin

claims.claim: That in-world newspaper opens a story with a dateline of in-world date and settlement, then a verbless list of the damage.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast, the Phandalin Post handout, reproduced on D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: Ches 25, Phandalin – Ambushed wagons, dead travelers, and a town
claims.page: 'Goblin Ambush Shocks Travelers on Triboar Trail'

claims.claim: That in-world newspaper attributes a quotation by given name, surname, office and institution, then the settlement.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast, the Phandalin Post handout, reproduced on D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: Linene Graywind, owner of Lionshield Coster in Phandalin
claims.page: 'Goblin Ambush Shocks Travelers on Triboar Trail'

claims.claim: The same newspaper attributes a tradesman by given name plus trade plus the institution he keeps.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast, the Phandalin Post handout, reproduced on D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: said Toblen, the innkeeper of the Stonehill Inn

claims.claim: In reported speech the same newspaper addresses the settlement's leader by office title plus surname, without a given name.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast, the Phandalin Post handout, reproduced on D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: What is Townmaster Wester going to do to keep us safe?
claims.page: 'Goblin Ambush Shocks Travelers on Triboar Trail'

claims.claim: Within one official article the same officer is called Townminster Weston in the editorial commentary and Townmaster Wester in the handout text.
claims.source: Mike Bernier, 'Downloadable Handout: Read the Latest Edition of the Phandalin Post', D&D Beyond, 5 Sep 2023
claims.quote: Townminster Weston hasn’t been of any help
claims.page: 'What's in This Issue of the Phandalin Post?'

claims.claim: A third official column opens a settlement entry with the settlement's name, its peoples and its region, in one sentence.
claims.source: Wizards of the Coast / D&D Beyond, 'Encounter of the Week: Storm Celebration', 2020
claims.quote: Boroftkrah is a settlement of orcs, half-orcs, and a few people

claims.claim: A reviewer locates the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide's settlement-creation tables in the toolbox chapter.
claims.source: Harvey Randall, PC Gamer, 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide review
claims.quote: the toolbox's ones for dungeons and settlement creation

claims.claim: The same reviewer judges those settlement tables a bullet-point list of suggestions rather than a guide to inventing one's own.
claims.source: Harvey Randall, PC Gamer, 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide review
claims.quote: more of a bullet-point list of suggestions than a guide

claims.claim: A read-through of the 2014 Dungeon Master's Guide names Random Settlements as a section of its chapter 5.
claims.source: Lex Starwalker, Game Master's Journey episode 235, 16 Dec 2018

claims.claim: The same read-through names Mapping a Settlement as another section of the 2014 guide's chapter 5.
claims.source: Lex Starwalker, Game Master's Journey episode 235, 16 Dec 2018
